SQL: SELECT c.course_code, c.title
FROM requirement_options ro
JOIN requirement_groups rg ON ro.requirement_group_id = rg.id
JOIN programs p ON rg.program_id = p.id
JOIN courses c ON ro.course_id = c.id
WHERE p.name = 'Computer Science'
  AND p.degree_type = 'BS'
  AND ro.is_required = 1
  AND c.course_code NOT IN (
    SELECT c2.course_code
    FROM requirement_options ro2
    JOIN requirement_groups rg2 ON ro2.requirement_group_id = rg2.id
    JOIN programs p2 ON rg2.program_id = p2.id
    WHERE p2.name = 'Computer Science'
      AND p2.degree_type = 'BS'
      AND ro2.is_required = 1
      AND c2.course_code IN ('CS 18000', 'CS 18200')
  );

sql:
SELECT ro.option_text, ro.credits, c.course_code, c.title 
FROM requirement_options ro 
JOIN courses c ON ro.course_id = c.id 
JOIN requirement_groups rg ON ro.requirement_group_id = rg.id 
JOIN programs p ON rg.program_id = p.id 
WHERE p.name = 'Computer Science'
